source.title: Cooper Creek 20160313_014852 solitary wolf howl very clear.wav
source.author: betchkal
source.notes: 44.1 kHz mono, 55 s, Alaska: four howls of about 8 s with a valley's reverb (T60 about 1.7 s, measured from the howls' tails). The late reverb is taken out (tails now gone within about 0.2 s, a little room kept) and the howls sped up 1.4x, pitch kept, to about 6 s; the wolf factory varies the pitch as they play (0.85-1.15). Chosen over Borgory's wolf pack (651193, CC0), which didn't suit even cleaned.
